subject: Game Theory
title: The Nash Demand Game
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Nash Demand Game.

hook.text: Both players simultaneously name how much they want. If demands total $100 or less, both get their ask.

buildup.text: If demands exceed $100, neither gets anything. Both must guess what the other will demand.

discovery.text: The equilibrium: both demand exactly $50. Any other symmetric claim risks exceeding the total.

twist.text: But there are infinite equilibria. One player demanding $90 and the other $10 is also stable, if both expect it.

climax.text: Focal points—cultural norms, precedent, or fairness conventions—select which equilibrium players land on.

punchline.text: What you demand depends on expectations.

quiz.question: What happens if both demands exceed the total?
